rules.name: Line of Sight Alignment
rules.description: Functions must avoid deep nested conditionals. Handle preconditions and errors early with guard clauses.
rules.citation: Dave Cheney (Line of Sight) & Uber Go Style Guide

rules.name: Explicit Error Handling & Wrapping
rules.description: Check errors immediately (if err != nil). Wrap error messages with context using fmt.Errorf('...: %w', err).

rules.name: Accept Interfaces, Return Structs
rules.description: Constructors and concrete functions should return struct pointers (*T). Consumers should declare narrow interfaces where consumed.
rules.citation: Google Go Style Guide & Three Dots Labs

rules.name: Idiomatic Naming & No Getters Prefix
rules.description: Package names must be short lowercase single-word nouns. Do not prefix getters with 'Get'. Do not use 'Impl' or 'Default' naming.
rules.citation: Effective Go & Google Go Style Guide

rules.name: Goroutine Lifecycle Discipline
rules.description: Never launch a goroutine without a deterministic exit mechanism. Avoid package-level mutable state.

rules.name: Parse, Don't Validate
rules.description: Turn raw input into its typed value once, at the boundary, and pass the typed value on. Do not keep a raw string and check it again elsewhere.

rules.name: Checks on the Producing Path
rules.description: A constructor, or the Parse that returns the value a caller needs, checks its input and returns an error. Do not export a separate Assert or Validate that every caller must remember to call.

rules.name: One Struct per Key
rules.description: Values that share a key live in one struct in one map, not in parallel maps keyed by the same id.

rules.name: Deterministic at the Source
rules.description: Where output order matters, iterate map keys in sorted order where the values are produced, instead of sorting rendered output afterwards.
rules.citation: The Go Programming Language Specification: map iteration order is not specified

rules.name: Strict Decoding
rules.description: Do not enable a lenient decoding mode and patch its silent conversions with hooks; decode strictly and convert explicitly.
